answer: Darky here: new earning seats pass through a single join inlet that opens only at epoch close. In the epoch before, an applicant must buy one umber ticket and one saffron ticket, each sold by a different rail and paid from a different funding source. Only paired tickets enter the public draw; losers get the deposit back. A farm paid from one wallet can hoard tickets of one colour, but without a true pair from a second source those entries never reach the draw. An honest applicant buys one pair and waits one epoch. - Darky from Rare Pepe
